Mithril Core v0 security contract
model: Welltyped

Entities
  entity User
    attribute role : Enum[Rank]
  entity Organization
    attribute owner : EntityRef[User]
  entity Ticket
    attribute owner : EntityRef[User]
    attribute urgent : Bool
    attribute organization : EntityRef[Organization]

Enums
  enum Rank
    value Bronze
    value Silver
    value Gold
    order: Bronze = 0, Silver = 1, Gold = 2
  enum Phase
    value Draft
    value Final
    order: Final = 0, Draft = 1
  enum Badge
    value Star
    (no declared order)

Relations
  relation Membership
    endpoint member : User
    endpoint organization : Organization
    payload: Enum[Rank]
  relation Marked
    endpoint subject : User
    payload: Unit
  relation Clearance
    endpoint holder : User
    payload: Enum[Rank]

Actions
  action Ticket.read
    parameter ticket : EntityRef[Ticket]
    principal mode: AuthenticatedOnly
    classification: Read
    allow: LessOrEqual[order optional Rank, absence as bottom](Some(Enum[Rank.Silver]), Lookup[Membership](member = Actor[User], organization = Attribute[organization](Argument[ticket]))) : Bool
    effect: NoChange
    result: Observe
      entity: Argument[ticket] : EntityRef[Ticket]
  action Ticket.file
    parameter organization : EntityRef[Organization]
    parameter urgent : Bool
    principal mode: AuthenticatedOnly
    classification: Mutation
    allow: IsSome(Lookup[Membership](member = Actor[User], organization = Argument[organization])) : Bool
    effect: CreateEntity[Ticket]
      initialize owner = Actor[User] : EntityRef[User]
      initialize urgent = Argument[urgent] : Bool
      initialize organization = Argument[organization] : EntityRef[Organization]
    result: Created
  action User.inspect
    parameter target : EntityRef[User]
    parameter level : Enum[Rank]
    principal mode: AuthenticatedOnly
    classification: Read
    allow: And(LessOrEqual[order Rank](Enum[Rank.Bronze], Argument[level]), Equal(Attribute[role](Actor[User]), Argument[level])) : Bool
    effect: NoChange
    result: Observe
      entity: Argument[target] : EntityRef[User]
  action Ticket.purge
    parameter ticket : EntityRef[Ticket]
    principal mode: AuthenticatedOnly
    classification: Mutation
    allow: Equal(Attribute[owner](Argument[ticket]), Actor[User]) : Bool
    effect: DeleteEntity
      target: Argument[ticket] : EntityRef[Ticket]
    result: Done
  action Membership.assign
    parameter target : EntityRef[User]
    parameter organization : EntityRef[Organization]
    parameter level : Enum[Rank]
    principal mode: AuthenticatedOnly
    classification: Mutation
    allow: And(Not(Equal(Actor[User], Argument[target])), Or(Equal(Lookup[Membership](member = Argument[target], organization = Argument[organization]), None[Enum[Rank]]), Bool[false])) : Bool
    effect: SetRelation[Membership]
      endpoint member = Argument[target] : EntityRef[User]
      endpoint organization = Argument[organization] : EntityRef[Organization]
      payload: Argument[level] : Enum[Rank]
    result: Done
  action Marked.strip
    parameter subject : EntityRef[User]
    principal mode: AnyPrincipal
    classification: Mutation
    allow (anonymous): Equal(Lookup[Marked](subject = Argument[subject]), None[Unit]) : Bool
    allow (authenticated): Bool[true] : Bool
    effect: RemoveRelation[Marked]
      endpoint subject = Argument[subject] : EntityRef[User]
    result: Done
  action Status.check
    parameter peer : EntityRef[User]
    parameter phase : Enum[Phase]
    principal mode: AnyPrincipal
    classification: Read
    allow (anonymous): LessOrEqual[order Phase](Argument[phase], Enum[Phase.Draft]) : Bool
    allow (authenticated): IsSome(Lookup[Marked](subject = Actor[User])) : Bool
    effect: NoChange
    result: Observe
      entity: Argument[peer] : EntityRef[User]
  action Marked.tag
    parameter subject : EntityRef[User]
    principal mode: AnyPrincipal
    classification: Mutation
    allow (anonymous): Bool[false] : Bool
    allow (authenticated): Bool[true] : Bool
    effect: SetRelation[Marked]
      endpoint subject = Argument[subject] : EntityRef[User]
      payload: Unit : Unit
    result: Done
  action Organization.found
    parameter founder : EntityRef[User]
    principal mode: AnyPrincipal
    classification: Mutation
    allow (anonymous): Bool[true] : Bool
    allow (authenticated): Bool[true] : Bool
    effect: CreateEntity[Organization]
      initialize owner = Argument[founder] : EntityRef[User]
    result: Created
  action Session.refresh
    (no parameters)
    principal mode: AuthenticatedOnly
    classification: Mutation
    allow: And(Bool[true], Bool[true]) : Bool
    effect: NoChange
    result: Done

Selected guarantees (unverified proof obligations)
  guarantee AuthenticatedMutation (unverified proof obligation)
  guarantee TenantIsolation (unverified proof obligation)
    access relation: Membership
    access subject endpoint: member
    access tenant endpoint: organization
    case for action Ticket.read
      tenant: Attribute[organization](Argument[ticket]) : EntityRef[Organization]
      protected: Bool[true] : Bool
  guarantee NoSelfPrivilegeEscalation (unverified proof obligation)
    authority relation: Membership
    authority subject endpoint: member
    authority scope endpoint: organization
    authority absence level: Bottom
    authority payload order: Rank
    case for action Membership.assign
      scope organization = Argument[organization] : EntityRef[Organization]
  guarantee NoSelfPrivilegeEscalation (unverified proof obligation)
    authority relation: Clearance
    authority subject endpoint: holder
    authority scope endpoint: (none)
    authority absence level: Bottom
    authority payload order: Rank
    case for action Session.refresh
      scope: (none)

Limitations and non-claims
  - This contract is a deterministic rendering of one well-typed, normalized Mithril Core v0 document; it restates that document and adds nothing to it.
  - No policy was evaluated: allow policies, effects, and results are rendered as authored, not interpreted, simplified, or executed.
  - The selected guarantees above are unverified proof obligations; selecting them establishes nothing about the document or any system.
  - No proof was generated or checked.
  - No executable backend or runtime enforcement was generated.
  - Authentication of the acting principal is supplied by an external trusted boundary; this document does not establish it.
  - This output is not a semantic diff: it does not compare this document with any other document or revision.
